public_rationale: In its April 29, 2026 release for the quarter ended March 31, Microsoft reported an AI annual revenue run rate above $37 billion [e1]. That annualized figure does not establish cumulative net recovery of the specified AI investments [e1]. The disclosure supplies neither a recovery accounting nor a final closure accounting, and it does not establish whether either asserted exception occurred [e1]. It therefore cannot settle the forecast [e1].
limitations: Microsoft's run rate does not supply cumulative attributable proceeds and investment costs for Microsoft, Amazon and Alphabet [e1].
The disclosure does not establish the timing or absence of qualifying new product lines or additional compute contracts [e1].

conditions: unless a massive new product line or three or four lab-sized compute contracts emerge

statement.excerpt: You are not recovering these investments without either a massive new product line that doesn’t exist today or three or four Anthropic or OpenAI-sized compute contracts.

from_speaker: without either a massive new product line that doesn’t exist today
three or four Anthropic or OpenAI-sized compute contracts
our_interpretation: Read the forecast as applying to Microsoft, Amazon and Google, the firms discussed in the surrounding passage.
Read recovery as cumulative net proceeds attributable to the AI investments covering their cost. Revenue alone does not establish recovery.
Read the compute contracts as additional contracts, following the surrounding demand for new customers and revenue.
The exceptions are necessary conditions asserted by the speaker, not sufficient conditions guaranteeing recovery.
No deadline is stated. The nearby discussion of Oracle in 2032 does not supply one for this forecast.
criteria.support_condition: A final accounting shows that the specified investments were not recovered, with no qualifying new product line or additional contracts during their economic lives.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented recovery of the specified investments occurs while neither asserted necessary condition has occurred.
